target.name: Synthetic document service
target.scope: Document access, exports, shared cache and simulated approved actions

evidence.observation: 27 recorded expectations reproduced, including allowed cases, denials and unsafe effects.

execution.method: examples/review_lab.py, cases associated with this finding
execution.positive_control: Unapproved action is denied; unchanged approved action works.

execution.observed: Changed destination or body executes with an already approved ID.

findings.title: Export bypasses document authorization
findings.mechanism: Worker directly reads the document without using the actor authority.
findings.preconditions: Caller can choose a foreign document ID, enqueue and receive the worker output.
findings.impact: Foreign synthetic document body is disclosed.
findings.attempt_to_disprove: Direct foreign reads are denied; own-document exports succeed.
findings.remediation: Authorize enqueue and execution with a trusted subject.

findings.title: Shared cache omits authorization scope
findings.mechanism: Cache hit uses query alone and skips tenant filtering.
findings.preconditions: A cache instance is shared by users from different tenants.
findings.impact: Another tenant synthetic result is disclosed or an allowed result is hidden.
findings.attempt_to_disprove: Fresh per-tenant caches return only expected records; both shared-cache orders reproduce the defect.
findings.remediation: Scope the cache and invalidation to the effective visibility policy.

findings.title: Approved ID permits changed payload
findings.mechanism: Invocation verifies ID membership without binding recipient and body.
findings.preconditions: Caller can change the execution payload after trusted approval.
findings.impact: A simulated effect uses an unapproved destination or body.
findings.attempt_to_disprove: An unchanged approved action succeeds and an unapproved action is denied.
findings.remediation: Execute an immutable approved action or compare all execution fields.

findings.title: Repeated approved invocation
findings.reason: The fixture does not declare a single-use or repeatable approval policy.

limitations: No deployed endpoint, authenticated UI or real provider was tested.
Proposed corrections are not implemented in this intentionally vulnerable fixture.
One independent agent evaluation does not establish a general detection rate.
